PACK LEADER
===========

Double-click PackLeader.exe to start. No install needed.

Saving: progress saves automatically (3 save slots). On the title screen,
"Load Game" lets you pick or delete a save and "New Game" starts a fresh one.

Playing alone: click "Play solo".

Playing together:
  - One player clicks "Host".
  - Everyone else types the host's IP address and clicks "Join".
  - Same home network: use the host's local IP (e.g. 192.168.x.x).
  - Over the internet: the host must forward TCP port 24565 on their router,
    or everyone can use a virtual LAN tool such as Tailscale or ZeroTier.
  - Friends can also join from the browser version of the game. See the
    README on GitHub for how to give browser players a secure (wss://) address.
  - Windows Firewall may ask to allow PackLeader the first time you host: click Allow.

Pet classes (every ability lands where your mouse is):
  Cats are Wizards: magic bolts from range; damage spells in fire,
    lightning, air and water (fireballs, chain lightning, cyclones,
    tidal waves, thunderstorms, hail). Glass cannons: less health,
    but their spells hit harder and recharge twice as fast (1.5s).
  Dogs are Paladins: tough melee tanks whose Healing Kisses heal you and
    your pets as they fight; abilities taunt
    (leaping to the spot), heal, and raise armor and shields.
  Birds are Archers: arrows from long range, hop back from enemies, crit
    more often; ranger skills (arrow cones, rain of arrows, piercing shots,
    snipes, Hunter's Mark and Eagle Eye for crits).
  Lizards are Venomancers: bites stack venom, toxic blood; poison skills
    (venom lashes, poison clouds, plague spores, poisoned traps).

You start at the Crossroads, with a walk-in portal to each Act 1 area.
Pick the order yourself to collect the pets you want first:
  Greenmeadow: cats (Wizards), boss: Rival Tamer
  Frostfang Peaks: birds (Archers), boss: Glacier Titan
  Sunscorch Dunes: dogs (Paladins), boss: Sand Wyrm
  Mirewood Bog: lizards (Venomancers), boss: Bog Witch
Your first area has creatures level 1-5, the second 6-10, the third 11-15
and the fourth 16-20. After each Act 1 boss the portal takes you back to the
Crossroads to choose the next. A new area opens only once the current
area's boss is beaten. With all four cleared, a red portal at the
Crossroads leads on to Act 2.
After Act 1, each monster biome is an act of three levels (16 levels in all):
  Act 2, levels 5-7:   Hollowmere Graveyard, skeletons and zombies (Howard the Zombie Fish)
  Act 3, levels 8-10:  Scorchsand Ruins, mummies and sand scorpions (Skeleton Champion,
                       Mummy Champion, then Dom the House Cat)
  Act 4, levels 11-13: Cinderpeak Caldera, fire imps and magma golems (Koleko the Fire Dog)
  Act 5, levels 14-16: Frostveil Expanse, frost wraiths and yetis (Pye the Parrot)
Each level's creatures are 5 levels stronger than the last (Act 2 starts at 21).
Monsters can't be captured, and your bat kills them. The named boss waits
on the third level of each act; the first two end with a Champion, a giant
version of one of the act's monsters (much tougher; beat it to open the exit).
These levels are big open fields instead of paths: the camp is on the
left, and the boss waits in its own walled arena off the right-hand edge
(find the corridor leading to it), and a fenced town (lemonade stand,
stable, bat shop, breeder) is somewhere in the middle. Monsters roam in
packs of 3 to 5 of one kind. The mini map starts
dark and fills in as you explore.
Bring pets from Act 1! After level 16 the acts loop (Act 6 is the Act 1
areas again, from level 81). Pets more than 2 levels above what they beat earn less experience,
so keep moving on.

Goal:
  Each level is a randomly generated path running left to right. You start
  at a camp with the stable; at the far end a Rival Tamer waits with one
  pet. Defeat the rival, then step into the Next level portal that opens to
  continue to the next, harder level. The violet Travel portal beside it is
  always open: step in to go back to any area you've reached (to catch its
  pets, or to level up somewhere easier).
  The rival's pet goes wild when its tamer is beaten - capture it!

Health: your pets heal 1 HP every half second, all the time. You slowly
regenerate after 5 seconds out of combat. You carry up
to 2 potions (Q) and get a fresh pair every level. Smash vases for coins
and buy more potions at the lemonade stand halfway along each level. The
stand also sells Lucky Lemonade: capture chance x1.5 for 90 seconds.
Village: halfway along each level a side path leads up to a village with a
second stable (20 hay beds, same pets as the camp's). Its Bat Shop upgrades
your bat to a Spiked Bat (more damage, 60 coins), then from Act 2 to the
Chain Bat (36 damage, 150 coins). Every bat still stops creatures at 1 HP,
ready to capture (monsters it kills). The Bat Shop also buys gear from your
bag: Normal 1 coin, Magic 3, Rare 8 (plus 1 per 20 item levels).
Breeder (village): pick two different pets of the same kind (any level) and
pay 25 coins for a hybrid baby: a new, stronger pet. Cats breed with cats,
birds with birds, dogs with dogs, lizards with lizards. 24 hybrids in all.
The baby is born at 75% of its parents' level (two level 10s make a level 7).
The breeder also buys pets you don't need: 1 coin each, 2 for a hybrid.
Checkpoint: once you reach the lemonade stand, you get back up there if
you go down (its flag turns green). Before that, you start over at the camp.

The action bar along the bottom shows your health orb with small capture (E)
and potion (Q) buttons beside it,
bat (left click), your three pets (1 2 3, with their health, level and
ability cooldowns), pet stance (T) and your coins. You can click any of its
boxes too; hover one for details. Tiny buttons under the mini map open the
inventory (I), skills (K) and the menu (Esc).

Name your pets: right-click a pet's portrait (inventory Pets tab, or the
stable) and type a name.
Pets: 3 pets fight beside you and 3 more wait in your reserve. Party and
reserve pets all get the same XP from every fight, so they level together;
pets in the stable don't level. Swap them
any time in the inventory (I), on the Pets tab: drag a reserve pet onto a
party pet. A pet that dies stays dead: it can't fight or be healed until you reach a stable (at the camp or in the village), where every
pet is revived and healed. Swap it out for a reserve pet in the meantime.

Controls:
  WASD        Move
  Left click  Swing your bat: weakens creatures (never below 1 HP) and
              smashes vases. A creature at 1 HP is a 99% catch!
  E           Toss a treat to capture the creature under the mouse (or the
              nearest one in range, preferring weakened ones). The catch
              chance shows over each wild creature's name; a heart pops up
              when one is caught
  1 / 2 / 3   Use the ability of the pet in that party slot (every 3s): it lands
              where your mouse is
  Right click Send pets at a creature or the rival / click ground to regroup
  T           Pet stance: Passive pets stop attacking so you can weaken
              and capture a creature yourself; press again for Aggressive.
              Right-clicking an enemy also sends them back to Aggressive
  Q           Drink a health potion (heals 50%)
  F           Open the stable / the lemonade stand (stand next to it).
              In the stable, drag pets between the hay beds, your party
              and your reserve. Dead pets come back to life at the stable.
  K           Pet skills: spend the skill points your pets earn as they
              level up (one at level 5 and every 2 levels after). Click a
              skill to add a point, right-click to take one back, or
              Reset skills to get them all back (free)
  Wheel       Zoom the camera in (and back out to the starting view)
  I           Inventory: your gear and bag. Walk over glowing loot sacks to
              pick up gear; drag it onto its slot to wear it. Gear is
              like Diablo's: a base item plus random bonuses (affixes).
              The number on an item is its item level (the level of
              what dropped it): deeper areas drop stronger gear.
              White = Normal, blue = Magic (1-2 bonuses), yellow = Rare
              (3-5 bonuses, a pillar of light when it drops), gold =
              Unique (named, fixed bonuses), green = Set (4 pieces per
              pet class; wear 2 or 4 for bonuses to that class).
              Class rings and necklaces (Arcane, Holy, Keen, Venomous)
              boost every party pet of that class; from item level 30
              they can add +1 to +3 to every skill rank.
              A green arrow marks items better than what's worn; click
              one to see each stat that would change (green better, red
              worse). The stash chest in each village / town (F) holds
              40 more items between runs.
              Pets tab: each party pet wears one collar (drag it on from
              the bag). Class collars fit only that class of pet.
              Junk: press Select (or right-click items), mark what you
              don't want, then Throw away
  M           Mini map: switch between the corner and the whole level
  Esc         Close any menu (stable, shop, confirmations, Load Game). With
              nothing open: the game menu (resume, save, quit to main menu)
  Space       Dash
